Inherits V0.9 product-group audit and adds business names/descriptions for shared links and public output hooks without changing flow, processing, batch, or accounting logic. The model remains a candidate, not B0/B1; calendar, changeover, reliability, physical batch semantics, cohort audit, and service behavior remain incomplete.

items.name: Log Resource Usage

Indicates whether usage related events for this resource are to be automatically logged. Go to Results -> Logs to view logged data. 

Note that using values that resolve to True at runtime but not at design time (such as table references) will result in the resource being added to the gantt view once it appears in the Resource Usage Log. Its gantt representation will not display Day or Downtime Exception rows, but that information can still be seen in the Work Day Exceptions and Work Period Exceptions repeat groups of the object instance.

items.name: Initial Capacity
items.description:
The initial fixed capacity of this resource.

NOTE: Refer to work schedules or the user-assignable 'CurrentCapacity' state variable of a resource to dynamically change its usage capacity during a simulation run.

items.name: Ranking Rule
items.description: The static ranking rule used to order seize requests waiting to be allocated capacity of this resource.

items.name: Dynamic Selection Rule
items.description: Indicates whether this resource, when its capacity becomes available, dynamically selects the next seize request from its statically ranked allocation queue using a dynamic selection rule.

items.name: Current Size and Orientation Index
items.description: The optional name of a state variable that indexes into the object's associated symbol list, and whose value will automatically resize and orient the object to match the size and orientation of the indexed symbol.

items.name: Transfer-In Constraints
items.description:
Indicates the type of constraints used to determine whether entities can transfer into this fixed object via external input nodes.

If specified as 'Default', then the 'Can Transfer In & Out Of Objects' property setting for the entity type will determine whether an entity can perform a transfer into the object.

items.name: Transfer-Out Constraints
items.description:
Indicates the type of constraints used to determine whether entities can transfer out of this fixed object via external output nodes.

If specified as 'Default', then the 'Can Transfer In & Out Of Objects' property setting for the entity type will determine whether an entity can perform a transfer out of the object.

items.name: Expected Setup Time Expression
items.description: The expression used to get a deterministic estimation of the setup time for an entity at this fixed object.

items.name: Expected Operation Time Expression
items.description: The expression used to get a deterministic estimation of the operation time for an entity at this fixed object.

items.name: Transfer-In Time
items.description: The time required to transfer an entity into this object.

items.name: Process Type
items.description: The method used to model the processing of an entity.

items.name: Processing Time
items.description: The time required to process an entity.

items.name: Off Shift Rule
items.description:
The processing rule used if the server is at the end of a shift because of its specified work schedule.

Suspend Processing - The server will immediately suspend all processing and set its resource state to 'OffShift'. Processing will resume at the start of the next shift.

Finish Work Already Started - The server will not accept any new entities but will continue processing if necessary to finish work already started. The server's resource state will be set to 'OffShiftProcessing' if processing entities during an off-shift period.

items.name: Resource Efficiency Rule
items.description:
The processing rule used to alter the rate at which work is performed if there are seized resources with defined efficiency values. The actual work duration is the planned work duration divided by the efficiency.

If the rule is ‘None’, then seized resource efficiency is ignored.

If the rule is ‘Average’, then the average seized resource efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Count’, then the number of seized resources with a defined efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Maximum’, then the largest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Minimum’, then the smallest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Sum’, then the sum of the seized resource efficiency values is used.

items.name: Seize Constraint Logic
items.description:
Constraint logic used to enforce additional constraints on an entity's request to seize the server.

NOTE: This repeat group applies only if the server has an input buffer. Otherwise, if no input buffer, then this constraint logic will be ignored.

childSchema.name: SeizeConstraintLogicName
childSchema.description: The name of the Constraint Logic element used to enforce additional constraints on an entity's request to seize the server.

items.name: Immediately Try Seize
items.description:
For an arriving entity, indicates whether to immediately try seizing the server before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skipping the server’s allocation queue.

Setting this property to False will just insert the seize request into the server’s allocation queue. An evaluation of that queue will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

NOTE: This property setting applies only if the server has an input buffer. Otherwise, if no input buffer, then an arriving entity will always immediately try to enter the server’s processing station and seize it.

items.name: Immediately Try Allocate When Released
items.description:
Once an entity has exited processing and released the server, indicates whether to immediately try allocating the released server capacity to waiting seize requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the server’s allocation queue will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

items.description: The number of discrete entities that can be held in the buffer.

items.name: Balk Decision Type
items.description:
The method used by an entity to decide whether to balk at entering the buffer.

If the decision type is ‘Blocked’, then an entity attempting to enter the buffer will balk if the buffer is full rather than be blocked. Or, if a zero capacity buffer, the entity will balk if its attempt to transfer directly into or out of the object is blocked.

items.name: Renege Triggers
items.description: Optional time or event-driven triggers that can cause entities to abandon waiting in the buffer.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeTriggerType
childSchema.description:
The type of trigger.

A time based trigger can renege an entity from the buffer once a specified wait duration expires.

An event based trigger can renege an entity from the buffer whenever a specified event occurs.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeWaitDuration
childSchema.description: The wait duration until deciding whether to renege an entity from the buffer.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeTriggeringEventName
childSchema.description: The name of the event whose occurrence will trigger a decision whether to renege an entity from the buffer.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeDecisionType
childSchema.description: The method used when the trigger has fired to decide whether to renege an entity from the buffer.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeConditionOrProbability
childSchema.description:
The renege condition or probability specified as an expression. If a probability then enter the chance of reneging as a value between 0.0 (0%) and 1.0 (100%).

NOTE: If it is necessary to check in a conditional expression whether an entity is currently waiting for a specific type of constraint, the entity ‘Queuing’ namespace provides several functions for that purpose (e.g., Entity.Queuing.IsWaitingRidePickupQueue).

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeNodeName
childSchema.description: Facility node location to send a reneging entity.

childSchema.name: InputBufferRenegeTriggerStartBoundary
childSchema.description: Indicates when the trigger becomes active for an entity occupying the buffer. Can be either immediately when the entity has entered the buffer or, alternatively, not until its transfer into the buffer has been ended (e.g., after a transfer-in time or any other entry related logic).

items.name: Resources For Processing
items.description: The secondary resources required to process an entity.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingResourceType
childSchema.description: The method for specifying the resource object(s) to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingResourceName
childSchema.description: The name of the resource object to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingResourceListName
childSchema.description: The name of the object list from which to select the resource object(s) to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingSelectionGoal
childSchema.description: The rule used to select a resource object from multiple candidates.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingSelectionValueExpression
childSchema.description:
The expression used to get the value for each candidate resource.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingRequestMove
childSchema.description: Indicates whether a move to a specified node will be requested from the seized resource(s). Processing will not be able to continue until arrival of the resources at the node location.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingDestinationNode
childSchema.description: The name of the destination node that the seized resource(s) will be requested to move to.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingNumberOfResources
childSchema.description: The number of individual resource objects to seize capacity units of.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingUnitsPerResource
childSchema.description:
The number of capacity units to seize per candidate resource.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingSelectionCondition
childSchema.description:
Optional condition evaluated for each candidate resource that must be true for the resource to be selected.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingResourceEfficiency
childSchema.description:
Optional value that can alter the rate at which work is performed using the seized resource(s), expressed as a fraction. The actual work duration is the planned work duration divided by the efficiency. Hence, an efficiency value greater than 1 shortens the time and a value less than 1 lengthens the time.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

Set this property to blank to declare the resource efficiency as undefined.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingKeepReservedCondition
childSchema.description:
Once an entity has completed processing and released the resource requirements, an optional condition indicating whether to keep the released resource capacity reserved for possible later reuse by the same entity. Other entities will be unable to use a reserved resource unless the reservation is cancelled.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource object being released (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

Note that when an entity is attempting to select a resource from a group of candidates (e.g., from a list or from a population of some resource type), by default a preference will be given to select a resource that has already been reserved by that entity irrespective of the specified selection goal.

Leaving this property blank (no condition) is equivalent to entering False.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingReservationTimeout
childSchema.description:
If the keep reserved condition is true, then an optional wait time before automatically cancelling the reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of resource object(s) being released (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingSkipRequirementCondition
childSchema.description: Optional condition indicating whether to skip the resource requirement.

items.name: Off Shift Rule
items.description:
The processing rule used if a resource is at the end of a shift because of its specified work schedule.

Suspend Processing - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be immediately suspended. Processing will resume at the start of the resource’s next shift.

Finish Work Already Started - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be allowed to continue until finished. The resource will not be allowed to accept any new work.

Switch Resources If Possible - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be immediately suspended. The entity will then try to resume processing as soon as possible by releasing the resource and seizing another available one that satisfies the same resource requirements.

items.name: Must Simultaneously Seize
items.description: If multiple resources are required, indicates whether all of the resources must be available before any can be seized.

items.name: Immediately Try Seize
items.description:
Indicates whether to immediately try seizing the resource requirements before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skipping the resource allocation queues.

Setting this property to False will just insert the seize request into the resource allocation queues. An evaluation of those queues will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

items.name: Immediately Try Allocate When Released
items.description:
Once an entity has completed processing and released the resource requirements, indicates whether to immediately try allocating the released resource capacity to waiting seize requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the resource allocation queues will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

completions.name: Abs( value )
completions.description: 返回指定数量的绝对值。一个数字的绝对值是其无符号的幅度。

completions.description: 返回指定数量（弧度）的反余弦值。

completions.name: AlmostEqual( value1, value2 )
completions.description:
Compares the two specified numbers and indicates whether they are almost equal using a combination of relative and absolute tolerances. 

If checking two finite numbers for approximate equality, then the result of this function will be equivalent to:

Math.Abs(value1 - value2) <= Math.Max(relativeTolerance * Math.Max(Math.Abs(value1), Math.Abs(value2)), absoluteTolerance)

relativeTolerance – The maximum allowed relative difference between the two specified numbers. For example, to set a tolerance of 5%, specify a relative tolerance of 0.05. Must be non-negative.

absoluteTolerance – The maximum allowed absolute difference between the two specified numbers. Particularly useful if comparing a number to zero. Must be non-negative.

The special values of NaN, Infinity, and -Infinity will be handled according to IEEE rules. Specifically, NaN is not considered equal to any other value, including NaN. Infinity and -Infinity are only considered equal to themselves.

items.name: Before Processing
items.description: Resource seizes when an entity has been allocated capacity to be processed at the object, but before entering (or ending transfer into) the object's processing station.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingResourceType
childSchema.description: The method for specifying the resource object(s) to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingResourceName
childSchema.description: The name of the resource object to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingResourceListName
childSchema.description: The name of the object list from which to select the resource object(s) to seize.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingSelectionGoal
childSchema.description: The rule used to select a resource object from multiple candidates.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingSelectionValueExpression
childSchema.description:
The expression used to get the value for each candidate resource.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingRequestMove
childSchema.description: Indicates whether a move to a specified node will be requested from the seized resource(s). Processing will not be able to continue until arrival of the resources at the node location.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingDestinationNode
childSchema.description: The name of the destination node that the seized resource(s) will be requested to move to.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingMovePriority
childSchema.description: The priority of the move request if a resource is selecting from multiple candidates.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingNumberOfResources
childSchema.description: The number of individual resource objects to seize capacity units of.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingUnitsPerResource
childSchema.description:
The number of capacity units to seize per candidate resource.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingSelectionCondition
childSchema.description:
Optional condition evaluated for each candidate resource that must be true for the resource to be selected.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingResourceEfficiency
childSchema.description:
Optional value that can alter the rate at which work is performed using the seized resource(s), expressed as a fraction. The actual work duration is the planned work duration divided by the efficiency. Hence, an efficiency value greater than 1 shortens the time and a value less than 1 lengthens the time.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

Set this property to blank to declare the resource efficiency as undefined.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingOnSeizedProcess
childSchema.description: Optional process to be executed when a resource is seized.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceSeizesBeforeProcessingSkipSeizeCondition
childSchema.description: Optional condition indicating whether to skip the seize requirement.

items.name: Before Processing
items.description: Resource releases when an entity has been allocated capacity to be processed at the object, but before entering (or ending transfer into) the object's processing station.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingResourceType
childSchema.description: The method for specifying the resource object(s) to release.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingResourceName
childSchema.description: The name of the resource object to release.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingResourceListName
childSchema.description: The name of the object list from which to select the resource object(s) to release.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingQuantityType
childSchema.description:
Indicates the type of resource quantity to release.

Specific – Is the exact quantities entered in the Number Of Objects and Units Per Object properties.

All – Is all currently seized resources of the specified resource type.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingNumberOfResources
childSchema.description: The number of individual resource objects to release capacity units of.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingUnitsPerResource
childSchema.description:
The number of capacity units to release per candidate resource.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingReleaseOrder
childSchema.description: The order in which to release the resources that have been seized by the entity.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingSelectionCondition
childSchema.description:
Optional condition evaluated for each seized resource that must be true for the resource to be selected.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource objects (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingKeepReservedCondition
childSchema.description:
Optional condition indicating whether to keep the released resource capacity reserved for possible later reuse by the same entity. Other entities will be unable to use a reserved resource unless the reservation is cancelled.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate resource object(s) being released (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

Note that when an entity is attempting to select a resource from a group of candidates (e.g., from a list or from a population of some resource type), by default a preference will be given to select a resource that has already been reserved by that owner irrespective of the specified selection goal.

Leaving this property blank (no condition) is equivalent to entering False.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingReservationTimeout
childSchema.description:
If the keep reserved condition is true, then an optional wait time before automatically cancelling the reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the resource object(s) being released (e.g., Candidate.Object.Capacity).

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingOnReleasedProcess
childSchema.description: Optional process to be executed when a resource is released.

childSchema.name: SecondaryResourceReleasesBeforeProcessingSkipReleaseCondition
childSchema.description: Optional condition indicating whether to skip the release requirement.

args.xml:
<Process Name="VSM_InitializeWIP" BeginStepID="2" Description="按 VSM_InitialWIPTable 在仿真初始化时按计算批次创建初始在制品；每个实体由 BatchUnitQuantity 表示工件件数，尾批可以小于20件；然后送入统一分流节点。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName" />
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition" />
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition" />
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Search" Name="遍历初始WIP记录" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CollectionType">TableRows</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectInstanceName" />
        <Property Name="ObjectType" />
        <Property Name="ObjectListName" />
        <Property Name="QueueStateName">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_InitialWIPTable</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchRelatedRowsOnly">False</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerObject">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NodeListName" />
        <Property Name="TransporterListName" />
        <Property Name="NodeName" />
        <Property Name="NetworkName">
          <Value>Global</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceObject">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SearchType">Forward</Property>
        <Property Name="MatchCondition">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount > 0</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchExpression">0.0</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveSearchExpressionSum">
          <Value>Token.ReturnValue</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="Limit">Infinity</Property>
        <Property Name="StartingIndex" />
        <Property Name="EndingIndex" />
        <Property Name="SaveIndexFound">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SaveNumberFound">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="CopyOverTableRowReferences">True</Property>
        <Property Name="SetTableRowConflictResolution">Replace</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Found" Type="Alternate" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Create" Name="按计算批次创建实体" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CreateType">NewObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OriginalEntityObject">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenAssociatedObject" />
        <Property Name="TokenContextObject" />
        <Property Name="NumberToCreate">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveCreatedEntityReference">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Created" Type="Alternate" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="初始化实体业务属性" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"WIP:" + VSM_InitialWIPTable.WIPRecordId</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ReleaseTimeHours</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.TrayID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Left", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialRightUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Right", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Transfer" Name="送入初始WIP分流节点" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="EntityType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityObject">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FromType">FreeSpace</Property>
        <Property Name="ToType">Node</Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName">Transfer_InitialWIP</Property>
        <Property Name="ExternalNodeName" />
        <Property Name="StationName">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ContainerName">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FacilityName" />
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkPreference">Default</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkRule">ShortestPath</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkName" />
        <Property Name="FlowRegulatorName">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="PathPlannerName">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
        <Property Name="FailIfBlocked">False</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilTransferred</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记初始库存来源" ID="6" Description="登记初始库存来源；按当前业务事件顺序执行。"><Properties><Property Name="StateVariableName"><Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value></Property><Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.SourceRow</Property><Property Name="Assignments"><Rows><Properties><Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName"><Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value></Property><Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received + ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property></Properties></Rows></Property></Properties><Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" /></Step></Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + 20</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">20</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/20)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="t0及每个有效工作日末在正常同刻事件之后记录盘点；Math.Epsilon使用原生晚优先级，不推进业务时钟。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">Run.TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍在本月" Description="仍在本月；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= 20</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * 55200 / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="把15个来源在6处的运行State冻结为输出行；低频日盘点；来源Received-Shipped-Scrapped-各处In+Out应为0。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="从首来源开始" Description="从首来源开始；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SnapshotSource</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增WIPSnapshot" Description="新增WIPSnapshot；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot</Property>
        <Property Name="KeyColumnValue"></Property>
        <Property Name="AddRowCondition"></Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结Stamping盘点" Description="冻结Stamping盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SnapshotTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SourceID</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Version</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ModelVersion</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Product</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Stage</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"Stamping"</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.InitialOrReleased</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Received</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Entered</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Exited</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.CurrentUnits</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Shipped</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Shipped</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SourceBalance</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Received - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Shipped - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Scrapped - (VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld2In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld2Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly1In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly1Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly2In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly2Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].FGStagingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].FGStagingOut)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增WIPSnapshot" Description="新增WIPSnapshot；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot</Property>
        <Property Name="KeyColumnValue"></Property>
        <Property Name="AddRowCondition"></Property>
      </Properties>

completions.name: AfterProcessingAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs when an entity has completed the processing time and is about to attempt its exit from the Server's processing station.

completions.name: AllocationQueue
completions.description: Accesses the queue of objects that are waiting to seize the resource.

completions.name: AssignmentsAfterProcessing
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity has completed its processing and is about to attempt its exit from the object's processing station.

completions.name: AssignmentsBeforeExiting
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity is ready to exit the object.

completions.name: AssignmentsBeforeProcessing
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity has been allocated capacity to be processed at the object, but before entering (or ending transfer into) the object's processing station.

completions.name: AssignmentsOnBalking
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity is balking at entering an input or output buffer of the object.

completions.name: AssignmentsOnEntering
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity is entering the object.

completions.name: AssignmentsOnReneging
completions.description: Optional state assignments when an entity is reneging from an input or output buffer of the object.

completions.name: BeforeProcessingAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs when an entity has been allocated Server capacity, but before entering (or ending transfer into) its processing station.

completions.name: Capacity
completions.description: Provides functions for accessing capacity usage information about this resource, such as the current number of units allocated as well as various functions for getting capacity utilization or cost statistics.

completions.name: CapacityType
completions.description: The capacity type of this resource.

completions.name: CapitalCost
completions.description: The initial one-time setup cost to add this object to the system.

completions.name: Cost
completions.description: Gets or sets the total cost that has been charged, or accrued, to the cost of the object. The value of this state may increase continuously over time based on the value of its Cost.Rate parameter.

completions.name: CurrentCapacity
completions.description: Gets or sets the current usage capacity of the resource.

completions.name: CurrentSizeIndex
completions.description: The optional name of a state variable that indexes into the object's associated symbol list, and whose value will automatically resize and orient the object to match the size and orientation of the indexed symbol.

completions.name: CurrentWorkSchedule
completions.description: Reference to the work schedule that is currently assigned to the resource.

completions.name: DirectDistanceTo
completions.description: Provides functions for getting a straight-line distance from this object's current location to another location.

completions.name: DisplayName
completions.description: String expression returning the name displayed for this object in log entries and trace. If not specified, then this property defaults to the object's unique name.

completions.name: DynamicSelectionRule
completions.description: Indicates whether this resource, when its capacity becomes available, dynamically selects the next seize request from its statically ranked allocation queue using a dynamic selection rule.

completions.name: Elements
completions.description:
Provides functions for accessing the direct child elements contained within this parent object.

NOTE: An object's child elements are listed in no particular order and the list can change if the object definition is updated. It is thus recommended to avoid model logic that depends on stable child element lists.

completions.name: EnteredAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs immediately after an entity has entered this object and is about to start the 'Transfer-In Time'.

completions.name: EvaluatingSeizeRequestAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs when this Server object is evaluating whether to accept or reject a request to seize capacity of the server. In the executed decision process, assigning a non-positive value to the executing token's ReturnValue state indicates that the seize request is rejected.

completions.name: ExitedAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs when an entity has exited this object.

completions.name: ExpectedOperationTimeExpression
completions.description: The expression used to get a deterministic estimation of the operation time for an entity at this fixed object.

completions.name: ExpectedOperationTimeFor( entity )
completions.description:
Returns an estimate of the expected operation time for a specified entity at this fixed object.

NOTE: Refer to the 'Expected Operation Time Expression' property in Advanced Options of the fixed object to specify the expression used to estimate an operation time for an entity.

completions.name: ExpectedSetupTimeExpression
completions.description: The expression used to get a deterministic estimation of the setup time for an entity at this fixed object.

completions.name: ExpectedSetupTimeFor( entity )
completions.description:
Returns an estimate of the expected setup time for a specified entity at this fixed object.

NOTE: Refer to the 'Expected Setup Time Expression' property in Advanced Options of the fixed object to specify the expression used to estimate a setup time for an entity.

completions.name: FailedAddOnProcess
completions.description: Occurs when this object has failed.

completions.name: Failure
completions.description: The failure occurrences for this object.

completions.name: FailureType
completions.description: Specifies whether this object has failures that affect the object's availability, and the method used to trigger the failure occurrences.

completions.name: Global
completions.description: A network containing all links in the system.

completions.name: HasActiveChangeover
completions.description: Returns True (1) if there is an active changeover occurrence at the resource. Otherwise, the value False (0) is returned.

completions.name: ID
completions.description: Returns the unique ID number of this object.

completions.name: ImmediatelyTryAllocateWhenReleased
completions.description:
Once an entity has exited processing and released the server, indicates whether to immediately try allocating the released server capacity to waiting seize requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the server’s allocation queue will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

completions.name: ImmediatelyTrySeize
completions.description:
For an arriving entity, indicates whether to immediately try seizing the server before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skipping the server’s allocation queue.

Setting this property to False will just insert the seize request into the server’s allocation queue. An evaluation of that queue will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

NOTE: This property setting applies only if the server has an input buffer. Otherwise, if no input buffer, then an arriving entity will always immediately try to enter the server’s processing station and seize it.

completions.name: ResourceEfficiencyRule
completions.description:
The processing rule used to alter the rate at which work is performed if there are seized resources with defined efficiency values. The actual work duration is the planned work duration divided by the efficiency.

If the rule is ‘None’, then seized resource efficiency is ignored.

If the rule is ‘Average’, then the average seized resource efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Count’, then the number of seized resources with a defined efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Maximum’, then the largest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Minimum’, then the smallest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Sum’, then the sum of the seized resource efficiency values is used.

completions.name: SecondaryResourcesForProcessingOffShiftRule
completions.description:
The processing rule used if a resource is at the end of a shift because of its specified work schedule.

Suspend Processing - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be immediately suspended. Processing will resume at the start of the resource’s next shift.

Finish Work Already Started - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be allowed to continue until finished. The resource will not be allowed to accept any new work.

Switch Resources If Possible - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be immediately suspended. The entity will then try to resume processing as soon as possible by releasing the resource and seizing another available one that satisfies the same resource requirements.

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">Run.TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="分配到期需求" Description="分配到期需求；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocateDemand</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍有工作日" Description="仍有工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= 20</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * 55200 / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="冻结期末结果" Description="冻结期末结果；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="8">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_FinalOutputs</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="EndRun" Name="完成本月当前事件" Description="完成本月当前事件；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="9">
      <Properties />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * VSM_WorkdayHours</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="分配到期需求" Description="分配到期需求；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocateDemand</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍有工作日" Description="仍有工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= VSM_NumberWorkdays</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * VSM_WorkdayHours</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="冻结期末结果" Description="冻结期末结果；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="8">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_FinalOutputs</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="EndRun" Name="完成本月当前事件" Description="完成本月当前事件；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="9">
      <Properties />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

completions.name: ImmediatelyTryAllocateWhenReleased
completions.description:
Once an entity has exited processing and released the server, indicates whether to immediately try allocating the released server capacity to waiting seize requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the server’s allocation queue will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

completions.name: ImmediatelyTrySeize
completions.description:
For an arriving entity, indicates whether to immediately try seizing the server before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skipping the server’s allocation queue.

Setting this property to False will just insert the seize request into the server’s allocation queue. An evaluation of that queue will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

NOTE: This property setting applies only if the server has an input buffer. Otherwise, if no input buffer, then an arriving entity will always immediately try to enter the server’s processing station and seize it.

completions.name: ResourceEfficiencyRule
completions.description:
The processing rule used to alter the rate at which work is performed if there are seized resources with defined efficiency values. The actual work duration is the planned work duration divided by the efficiency.

If the rule is ‘None’, then seized resource efficiency is ignored.

If the rule is ‘Average’, then the average seized resource efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Count’, then the number of seized resources with a defined efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Maximum’, then the largest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Minimum’, then the smallest efficiency value is used.

If the rule is ‘Sum’, then the sum of the seized resource efficiency values is used.

Suspend Processing - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be immediately suspended. Processing will resume at the start of the resource’s next shift.

Finish Work Already Started - The processing of the entity that is using the resource will be allowed to continue until finished. The resource will not be allowed to accept any new work.

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + 20</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">20</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/20)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>

columnDetails.name: row_index
columnDetails.description: Zero-based row index.

columnDetails.name: WIPRecordId
columnDetails.description: 唯一的初始 WIP 记录编号；按位置和产品汇总，用于追踪每条初始化记录。

columnDetails.name: ArrivalTime
columnDetails.description: 初始 WIP 创建时刻，单位小时；本版本全部为仿真时刻 0。

columnDetails.name: EntitiesPerArrival
columnDetails.description: 该行对应的原始工件数量，保留来源数据口径；不再直接作为Simio实体创建数。单位：件。

columnDetails.name: Location
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化时的业务位置，例如工序前缓冲或成品暂存区。

columnDetails.name: ProductType
columnDetails.description: 产品族编码：Left 或 Right；用于实体初始化标签。

columnDetails.name: CurrentResource
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化后进入的当前设备对象引用；只用于表驱动分流，不表示历史已经加工的资源。

columnDetails.name: ProductionBatch
columnDetails.description: 初始化批次标签；用于保留现有模型的批次语义。

columnDetails.name: ReleaseTimeHours
columnDetails.description: 原始释放时间快照，单位小时；初始 WIP 本版本固定为 0。

columnDetails.name: TrayID
columnDetails.description: 候选托盘号；历史托盘未重建时使用 0。

columnDetails.name: BatchEntityCount
columnDetails.description: 该表行需要创建的Simio实体数；通常为总工件数除以20向下取整，尾批另占一行。单位：实体；由初始化过程读取。

columnDetails.name: BatchUnitQuantity
columnDetails.description: 每个创建实体代表的工件数；标准批次为20，W03-R尾批为10。单位：件/实体；由初始化过程写入实体数量状态。

columnDetails.name: SourceRow
columnDetails.description: 直接来源台账行号1–11；避免每次流转全表搜索。

items.name: Entities Per Arrival
items.description: The number of entities that will be created by this Source object for each arrival event.

items.name: Maximum Arrivals
items.description: A limit on the total number of arrivals to be automatically generated by this Source object during the simulation run.

          </Rows>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>

    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">

              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>
