args.xml:
<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName" />
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition" />
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition" />
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

columnDetails.name: row_index
columnDetails.description: Zero-based row index.

columnDetails.name: WIPRecordId
columnDetails.description: 唯一的初始 WIP 记录编号；按位置和产品汇总，用于追踪每条初始化记录。

columnDetails.name: ArrivalTime
columnDetails.description: 初始 WIP 创建时刻，单位小时；本版本全部为仿真时刻 0。

columnDetails.name: EntitiesPerArrival
columnDetails.description: 该行对应的原始工件数量，保留来源数据口径；不再直接作为Simio实体创建数。单位：件。

columnDetails.name: Location
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化时的业务位置，例如工序前缓冲或成品暂存区。

columnDetails.name: ProductType
columnDetails.description: 产品族编码：Left 或 Right；用于实体初始化标签。

columnDetails.name: CurrentResource
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化后进入的当前设备对象引用；只用于表驱动分流，不表示历史已经加工的资源。

columnDetails.name: ProductionBatch
columnDetails.description: 初始化批次标签；用于保留现有模型的批次语义。

columnDetails.name: ReleaseTimeHours
columnDetails.description: 原始释放时间快照，单位小时；初始 WIP 本版本固定为 0。

columnDetails.name: TrayID
columnDetails.description: 候选托盘号；历史托盘未重建时使用 0。

columnDetails.name: BatchEntityCount
columnDetails.description: 该表行需要创建的Simio实体数；通常为总工件数除以20向下取整，尾批另占一行。单位：实体；由初始化过程读取。

columnDetails.name: BatchUnitQuantity
columnDetails.description: 每个创建实体代表的工件数；标准批次为20，W03-R尾批为10。单位：件/实体；由初始化过程写入实体数量状态。

columnDetails.name: SourceRow
columnDetails.description: 直接来源台账行号1–11；避免每次流转全表搜索。

items.name: Entities Per Arrival
items.description: The number of entities that will be created by this Source object for each arrival event.

items.name: Maximum Arrivals
items.description: A limit on the total number of arrivals to be automatically generated by this Source object during the simulation run.

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * VSM_WorkdayHours</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="分配到期需求" Description="分配到期需求；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocateDemand</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍有工作日" Description="仍有工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= VSM_NumberWorkdays</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * VSM_WorkdayHours</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="冻结期末结果" Description="冻结期末结果；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="8">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_FinalOutputs</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="EndRun" Name="完成本月当前事件" Description="完成本月当前事件；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="9">
      <Properties />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>

          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍有工作日" Description="仍有工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= VSM_NumberWorkdays</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="冻结期末结果" Description="冻结期末结果；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="8">
      <Properties>

        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="EndRun" Name="完成本月当前事件" Description="完成本月当前事件；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="9">

</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

warnings.content: 这可能表明，有一个在模型中创建过多实体或不破坏它们的逻辑问题。需要注意的是这样的问题，最终可能导致过多的计算机内存被消耗造成Simio变得不稳定。如果人口众多实体的模型，那么这个警告可以忽略不计。

args.xml:
<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(1,101),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState) / 3600</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

items.name: 说明
items.value: Michigan Steel VSM V0.10: common skeleton candidate. Inherits V0.9 product-group audit and adds business names/descriptions for shared links and public output hooks without changing flow, processing, batch, or accounting logic. The model remains a candidate, not B0/B1; calendar, changeover, reliability, physical batch semantics, cohort audit, and service behavior remain incomplete.
