<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName" />
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition" />
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition" />
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

completions.name: CanTransferInAndOutOfObjects
completions.description: Indicates whether entities of this type are by default allowed to transfer into and out of fixed objects via those object's external input/output nodes.

completions.name: CurrentSizeIndex
completions.description: The optional name of a state variable that indexes into the object's associated symbol list, and whose value will automatically resize and orient the object to match the size and orientation of the indexed symbol.

completions.name: Destroyable
completions.description: Specifies whether objects of this type can be destroyed using the Destroy step.

completions.name: DisplayName
completions.description: String expression returning the name displayed for this object in log entries and trace. If not specified, then this property defaults to the object's unique name.

completions.name: DueDateExpression
completions.description: The expression used to return a 'due date' value for an entity of this type.

completions.name: FreeSpaceSteeringBehavior
completions.description:
The behavior used to steer an entity of this type when traveling in free space to a destination.

'Direct To Destination' will steer an entity in a straight line to its destination.

'Follow Network Path If Possible' will prefer to steer an entity along a path following its currently assigned network, staying within the boundaries of the drawn path width. The Entity will travel based on the drawn length of the path even if a different logical length is specified. However, if no followable network path exists to the entity's destination then the entity will be steered in a straight line. Note: In order to use this steering behavior, make sure the entity's travel mode is set to 'Free Space Only'.

completions.name: GanttVisibilityExpression
completions.description: An expression evaluated at run time to determine if the agent/entity should appear in the Entity Gantt window.

completions.name: InitialCost
completions.description: The initial value of the 'Cost' state for an object of this type, which stores the total cost that has been charged, or accrued, to the object. The 'Cost' state variable of an object is user-assignable.

completions.name: InitialCostRate
completions.description: The initial value of the 'Cost.Rate' parameter for an object of this type, which indicates a cost per unit time that is to be charged, or accrued, to the cost of the object. The 'Cost.Rate' state variable parameter of an object is user-assignable.

completions.name: InitialDesiredSpeed
completions.description:
The initial desired speed value for entities of this type.

NOTE: Refer to the user-assignable 'DesiredSpeed' state variable of an entity to dynamically change its desired speed during a simulation run.

completions.name: InitialNetwork
completions.description:
The initial network of links followed by entities of this type.

NOTE: Refer to the user-assignable 'CurrentNetwork' state variable of an entity to dynamically change its network during a simulation run. The SetNetwork step may also be used to assign a new network to an entity.

completions.name: InitialNumberInSystem
completions.description: The initial number of entities of this type in the system at the beginning of the simulation run.

completions.name: InitialPriority
completions.description:
The initial priority value for entities of this type.

NOTE: Refer to the user-assignable 'Priority' state variable of an entity to dynamically change its priority value during a simulation run.

completions.name: InitialSequence
completions.description:
An initial destination sequence that entities of this type use for routing purposes.

NOTE: Refer to the SetRow process step to dynamically change an entity's sequence table or sequence table row reference during a simulation run.

completions.name: InitialTravelMode
completions.description:
The initial travel mode for entities of this type.

'Free Space Only' indicates that the entities are required to perform travel movements in free space.

'Network Only' indicates that the entities are required to perform travel movements using the currently assigned network.

'Network If Possible' indicates a preference for the entities to perform travel movements using the currently assigned network, but if no followable network path exists to the next destination then travel in free space is allowed.

NOTE: Refer to the user-assignable 'CurrentTravelMode' state variable of an entity to dynamically change its travel mode during a simulation run. An entity's travel mode may also be changed using the 'Outbound Travel Mode' property provided by a node.

completions.name: Is
completions.description: “是”的一类或类型名称关键字，然后返回值为True（1），如果该项目是该类别或类型。否则，返回False值（0）。

completions.name: MaximumNumberInSystemLimit
completions.description: The maximum number of entities of this type that should simultaneously exist in the system. Exceeding this limit will result in a runtime warning.

completions.name: Name
completions.description: 返回的字符串名称资料。

completions.name: NetworkTurnaroundMethod
completions.description:
When traveling on a network, the default method used by entities of this type to turn around at a node in order to move in the opposite direction on a bidirectional link. 

NOTE: A network element's 'Turnaround Method' property may be used to override this entity default on a network-by-network basis.

completions.description: Returns a reference to the first member in the current population of this entity's type.

completions.name: IndexOfItem( entity )
completions.description: Returns the one-based member index of a specified entity in the current population of this entity's type. If the population does not contain the entity then the value 0 is returned.

completions.name: LastItem

completions.name: NumberCreated
completions.description: Returns the total number of entities of this entity's population type that have been created.

completions.name: NumberDestroyed
completions.description: Returns the total number of entities of this entity's population type that have been destroyed.

completions.name: NumberInSystem
completions.description: Returns the current number of entities of this entity's population type in the system.

completions.name: TimeInSystem
completions.description: Provides functions for getting summary statistics on the time spent in system by completed entities of this entity's population type.

completions.name: Allocated
completions.description: Returns the current number of capacity units of this resource that are allocated (have been seized). Note that this resource's allocated capacity units may not necessarily be considered 'utilized' for resource utilization calculation purposes. Use the Capacity.Utilized function to return the current number of 'utilized' capacity units.

completions.name: AllocatedTo( owner )
completions.description: Returns the current number of capacity units of this resource that are allocated to (have been seized by) a specified owner object.

completions.name: Average
completions.description: Returns the average scheduled capacity of this resource during the run.

completions.name: IdleCost
completions.description: Returns the total cost that has been accrued to the cost of this resource due to idle capacity units.

completions.name: Initial
completions.description: Returns the initial scheduled capacity of this resource.

completions.name: Maximum
completions.description: Returns the maximum scheduled capacity of this resource during the run.

completions.name: Minimum
completions.description: Returns the minimum scheduled capacity of this resource during the run.

completions.name: Next
completions.description: Returns the next scheduled capacity of this resource.

completions.name: Previous
completions.description: Returns the previous scheduled capacity of this resource.

completions.name: Remaining
completions.description: Returns the current unallocated capacity of this resource.

completions.name: Reserved
completions.description: Returns the current number of capacity units of this resource that are reserved.

completions.name: ReservedTo( owner )
completions.description: Returns the current number of capacity units of this resource that are reserved for use by a specified owner object.

completions.name: ScheduledUtilization
completions.description: Returns the percent utilization of this resource's scheduled capacity during the run, calculated by returning the value of the expression '100 * (Capacity.Utilized.Average / Capacity.Average)'.

completions.name: TimeOfLastChange
completions.description: Returns the simulation time (in hours) that the capacity of this resource most recently changed.

completions.name: TimeOfNextChange
completions.description: Returns the simulation time (in hours) of the next scheduled capacity change of this resource.

completions.name: TimeSinceLastChange
completions.description: Returns the elapsed time duration (in hours) since the most recent capacity change of this resource.

completions.name: TimeUntilNextChange
completions.description: Returns the time duration remaining (in hours) until the next scheduled capacity change of this resource.

completions.name: UsageCostCharged
completions.description: Returns the total cost that has been charged to users of this resource's capacity.

completions.name: Utilized
completions.description: Returns the current number of capacity units of this resource that are allocated and considered utilized. This resource's ResourceState variable determines which state values are considered utilized.

columnDetails.name: row_index
columnDetails.description: Zero-based row index.

columnDetails.name: WIPRecordId
columnDetails.description: 唯一的初始 WIP 记录编号；按位置和产品汇总，用于追踪每条初始化记录。

columnDetails.name: ArrivalTime
columnDetails.description: 初始 WIP 创建时刻，单位小时；本版本全部为仿真时刻 0。

columnDetails.name: EntitiesPerArrival
columnDetails.description: 该行对应的原始工件数量，保留来源数据口径；不再直接作为Simio实体创建数。单位：件。

columnDetails.name: Location
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化时的业务位置，例如工序前缓冲或成品暂存区。

columnDetails.name: ProductType
columnDetails.description: 产品族编码：Left 或 Right；用于实体初始化标签。

columnDetails.name: CurrentResource
columnDetails.description: 实体初始化后进入的当前设备对象引用；只用于表驱动分流，不表示历史已经加工的资源。

columnDetails.name: ProductionBatch
columnDetails.description: 初始化批次标签；用于保留现有模型的批次语义。

columnDetails.name: ReleaseTimeHours
columnDetails.description: 原始释放时间快照，单位小时；初始 WIP 本版本固定为 0。

columnDetails.name: TrayID
columnDetails.description: 候选托盘号；历史托盘未重建时使用 0。

columnDetails.name: BatchEntityCount
columnDetails.description: 该表行需要创建的Simio实体数；通常为总工件数除以20向下取整，尾批另占一行。单位：实体；由初始化过程读取。

columnDetails.name: BatchUnitQuantity
columnDetails.description: 每个创建实体代表的工件数；标准批次为20，W03-R尾批为10。单位：件/实体；由初始化过程写入实体数量状态。

columnDetails.name: SourceRow
columnDetails.description: 直接来源台账行号1–11；避免每次流转全表搜索。

items.name: Entities Per Arrival
items.description: The number of entities that will be created by this Source object for each arrival event.

items.name: Maximum Arrivals
items.description: A limit on the total number of arrivals to be automatically generated by this Source object during the simulation run.

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

completions.name: BatchLogic
completions.description: A Batch Logic element may be used in conjunction with the Batch step to group multiple entities together and then attach the batch members to a parent entity.

completions.name: BillOfMaterials
completions.description:
A Bill Of Materials (BOM) element may be used to define a comprehensive list of the component materials required to manufacture a product.

Multiple BOMs that describe alternative lists of component materials to manufacture one product may be grouped together using the Bill Of Materials Group element.

completions.name: BillOfMaterialsGroup
completions.description:
A Bill Of Materials (BOM) Group element may be used to group together BOMs that describe alternative lists of component materials to manufacture one product.

Refer to the Bill Of Materials element to define a single BOM.

completions.name: ChangeoverLogic
completions.description: A Changeover Logic element may be used in conjunction with the Changeover step to model sequence dependent setups at one or more associated resources.

completions.name: ConstraintLogic
completions.description: A Constraint Logic element may be used to enforce material availability, resource availability, or condition expression constraints on a constrainable process step (e.g., a Seize or Route step).

completions.name: Container
completions.description: A Container element may be used to define a volume or weight capacity constrained location for holding entities representing quantities of fluids or other mass. Use the Transfer step to initiate transfers of flow entities into or out of a container.

completions.name: CostCenter
completions.description: A Cost Center element may be used to define an identifiable area of responsibility where costs are allocated or incurred. Cost centers may be linked in a hierarchical structure for cost accounting and reporting purposes, whereby costs are automatically rolled up through the cost center hierarchy.

completions.name: Counter
completions.description:
A Counter element may be used to track attribute-based counts of entities in the system.

NOTE: A counter's key and value expressions are evaluated once for an entity to increment a count and those results then cached for later use when it is time to decrement the count.

completions.name: Failure
completions.description: A Failure element may be used to define a type of resource failure that occurs in the system. Failure downtime occurrences are started and ended using the Fail and Repair steps.

completions.name: InitialValue
completions.description: Returns the initial value of the state.

completions.name: Inventory
completions.description: An Inventory element may be used to manage the stock on hand of a specific material for a specific location in the system. A Site Object Name property is provided to designate a fixed object in the Facility window as the inventory's location identifier.

completions.name: Material
completions.description:
A Material element may be used to define a material that is used, held, or produced in the system. For a material representing an end product, a bill of materials list may be entered that specifies the component materials required to make one unit of the parent material.

The stock on hand of a material may be managed at separate locations in a system using Inventory elements.

Refer to the Storage Area and Storage Bin elements for additional features related to material storage.

Refer to the Consume and Produce steps to consume or produce material quantities.

completions.name: Monitor
completions.description: A Monitor element may be used to detect discrete or threshold crossing state changes.

completions.name: Network
completions.description:
A Network element may be used to define a network of links for entities to travel between node locations. Refer to the SetNetwork step to set an entity's current network. Alternatively, the Assign step may be used to assign an entity's CurrentNetwork state variable.

Path planning features are available to find and reserve a network deadlock-free shortest path for an entity from its current node to a destination node. Refer to the Path Planner element for more information.

completions.name: NeuralNetwork
completions.description:
A Neural Network element may be used to integrate a neural network regression model into simulation logic.

This element provides an Input Value Expressions repeat group for mapping dynamic expressions to the associated neural network model’s input layer. To use the neural network for regression during a simulation run, a PredictedValue function is provided that evaluates the mapped input value expressions in the context of a specified object. Then, for the resulting set of input values, the associated neural network model is run to return a predicted output value.

Simulation event-driven triggers to record synthetic training data for the associated neural network model may also optionally be defined.

Refer to the Data -> Neural Network Models view to create, train, and manage neural network regression models.

completions.name: OutputStatistic
completions.description: An Output Statistic element may be used to record and report statistics on the value of a specified expression.

completions.name: PathPlanner
completions.description: A Path Planner element may be used in conjunction with a Transfer step to find and reserve a network deadlock-free shortest path for an entity from its current node to a destination node.

completions.name: PeriodicStatistic
completions.description: A Periodic Statistic element may be used in conjunction with an Output Statistic, State Statistic, or Tally Statistic element to periodically record and report statistics for distinct time periods (e.g., daily or weekly statistics recording).

completions.name: Process
completions.description: A Process element defines a sequence of logical steps that may be executed by tokens during a simulation run.

completions.name: RandomValue
completions.description: Returns the value of this state (table column) for a randomly selected row in the table, whereby each row has an equal probability of being selected.

completions.name: Regulator
completions.description: A Regulator element may be used to regulate flow transfers of entities into or out of locations.

completions.name: RoutingGroup
completions.description: A Routing Group element may be used in conjunction with a Route step or TransferNode object to route an entity to a location selected from a list of possible destination nodes.

completions.name: StateStatistic
completions.description: A State Statistic element may be used to record and report statistics on the value of a specified state variable.

completions.name: Station
completions.description: A Station element may be used to define a capacity constrained location for holding entities representing discrete items. Use the Transfer step to initiate transfers of entities into or out of a station.

completions.name: StockQuant
completions.description: Represents a stock of specific material with the same characteristics in a storage bin.

completions.name: Storage
completions.description:
A Storage element may be used to define a logical queue of objects. Inserting an object into a storage has no impact on that object’s physical location, and an object may be inserted into multiple storages at the same time.

Refer to the Insert and Remove steps to insert or remove an object from a storage.

completions.name: StorageArea
completions.description: A Storage Area element may be used to define a logical grouping of material storage areas or bins for modeling stock putaway or removal processes.

completions.name: StorageBin
completions.description:
A Storage Bin element may be used to define a capacity constrained storage location for holding stock of one or more materials.

Refer to the AddStock and RemoveStock steps to physically add stock to or remove stock from a storage bin.

Refer to the ReserveBins step to reserve storage bin capacity for an entity's material stock putaway requirements.

Refer to the ReserveStock step to reserve storage bin stock for an entity's material stock removal requirements.

completions.name: TallyStatistic
completions.description: A Tally Statistic element may be used in conjunction with the Tally step to record and report statistics on a set of observed values.

completions.name: TaskSequence
completions.description: A Task Sequence element may be used to more easily define and execute structured sequences of processing tasks. Refer to the StartTasks step to start a task sequence that is associated with an object in the system.

completions.name: Timer
completions.description: A Timer element may be used to fire a stream of events according to a specified interval type.
