<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>

          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>

      <Properties>

        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= VSM_NumberWorkdays</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>

        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>

        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />

      <Properties />

        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareStamping" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_StampingLastProduct!="" && VSM_StampingLastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[1].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记本次设备产品" Description="登记本次设备产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_StampingSetupCount</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_StampingSetupCount+Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime>0,1,0)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_StampingLastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_InitializeWIP" BeginStepID="2" Description="按 VSM_InitialWIPTable 在仿真初始化时按计算批次创建初始在制品；每个实体由 BatchUnitQuantity 表示工件件数，尾批可以小于20件；然后送入统一分流节点。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Search" Name="遍历初始WIP记录" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CollectionType">TableRows</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectInstanceName"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectType"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="QueueStateName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_InitialWIPTable</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchRelatedRowsOnly">False</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NodeListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="TransporterListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NetworkName">
          <Value>Global</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SearchType">Forward</Property>
        <Property Name="MatchCondition">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount > 0</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchExpression">0.0</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveSearchExpressionSum">
          <Value>Token.ReturnValue</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="Limit">Infinity</Property>
        <Property Name="StartingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="EndingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="SaveIndexFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SaveNumberFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="CopyOverTableRowReferences">True</Property>
        <Property Name="SetTableRowConflictResolution">Replace</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Found" Type="Alternate" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Create" Name="按计算批次创建实体" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CreateType">NewObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OriginalEntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenAssociatedObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="TokenContextObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="NumberToCreate">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveCreatedEntityReference">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Created" Type="Alternate" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="初始化实体业务属性" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"WIP:" + VSM_InitialWIPTable.WIPRecordId</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ReleaseTimeHours</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.TrayID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Left", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialRightUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Right", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Transfer" Name="送入初始WIP分流节点" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="EntityType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FromType">FreeSpace</Property>
        <Property Name="ToType">Node</Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName">Transfer_InitialWIP</Property>
        <Property Name="ExternalNodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="StationName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ContainerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FacilityName"></Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkPreference">Default</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkRule">ShortestPath</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkName"></Property>
        <Property Name="FlowRegulatorName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="PathPlannerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
        <Property Name="FailIfBlocked">False</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilTransferred</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记初始库存来源" Description="登记初始库存来源；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.SourceRow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received + ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>

          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">

items.name: Global
items.description:
A Network element may be used to define a network of links for entities to travel between node locations. Refer to the SetNetwork step to set an entity's current network. Alternatively, the Assign step may be used to assign an entity's CurrentNetwork state variable.

Path planning features are available to find and reserve a network deadlock-free shortest path for an entity from its current node to a destination node. Refer to the Path Planner element for more information.

<Process Name="VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="把15个来源在6处的运行State冻结为输出行；低频日盘点；来源Received-Shipped-Scrapped-各处In+Out应为0。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="从首来源开始" Description="从首来源开始；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SnapshotSource</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增WIPSnapshot" Description="新增WIPSnapshot；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot</Property>
        <Property Name="KeyColumnValue"></Property>
        <Property Name="AddRowCondition"></Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结Stamping盘点" Description="冻结Stamping盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SnapshotTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SourceID</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Version</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ModelVersion</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Product</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Stage</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"Stamping"</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.InitialOrReleased</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Received</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Entered</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Exited</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.CurrentUnits</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Shipped</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Shipped</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SourceBalance</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Received - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Shipped - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Scrapped - (VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].StampingOut + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld2In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld2Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly1In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly1Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly2In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Assembly2Out + VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].FGStagingIn - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].FGStagingOut)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Replication</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Run.ReplicationNumber</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.RandomnessDisabled</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(Run.RandomnessDisabled,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增WIPSnapshot" Description="新增WIPSnapshot；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot</Property>
        <Property Name="KeyColumnValue"></Property>
        <Property Name="AddRowCondition"></Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结Weld1盘点" Description="冻结Weld1盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SnapshotTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.SourceID</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Version</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ModelVersion</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Product</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Stage</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"Weld1"</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.InitialOrReleased</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Received</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Entered</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1In</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Exited</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1Out</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.CurrentUnits</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1In - VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Weld1Out</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_WIPSnapshot.Shipped</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_SnapshotSource].Shipped</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

<Process Name="VSM_InitializeWIP" BeginStepID="2" Description="按 VSM_InitialWIPTable 在仿真初始化时按计算批次创建初始在制品；每个实体由 BatchUnitQuantity 表示工件件数，尾批可以小于20件；然后送入统一分流节点。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Search" Name="遍历初始WIP记录" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CollectionType">TableRows</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectInstanceName"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectType"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="QueueStateName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_InitialWIPTable</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchRelatedRowsOnly">False</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NodeListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="TransporterListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NetworkName">
          <Value>Global</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SearchType">Forward</Property>
        <Property Name="MatchCondition">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount > 0</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchExpression">0.0</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveSearchExpressionSum">
          <Value>Token.ReturnValue</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="Limit">Infinity</Property>
        <Property Name="StartingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="EndingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="SaveIndexFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SaveNumberFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="CopyOverTableRowReferences">True</Property>
        <Property Name="SetTableRowConflictResolution">Replace</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Found" Type="Alternate" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Create" Name="按计算批次创建实体" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CreateType">NewObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OriginalEntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenAssociatedObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="TokenContextObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="NumberToCreate">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveCreatedEntityReference">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Created" Type="Alternate" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="初始化实体业务属性" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"WIP:" + VSM_InitialWIPTable.WIPRecordId</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ReleaseTimeHours</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.TrayID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Left", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialRightUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Right", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Transfer" Name="送入初始WIP分流节点" ID="5">

    <Step Type="Decide" Name="需求行仍存在" Description="需求行仍存在；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_AllocDemand <= 40</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="14" />

    <Step Type="Decide" Name="需求已到期" Description="需求已到期；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DueTime <= TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="14" />

      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].Allocated >= VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DemandUnits</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />

      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">

        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_AllocDemand+2</Property>

        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_AllocStock > 0</Property>

        <Property Name="StateVariableName">

              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

            <Properties>

            <Properties>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_ShippedRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ShippedRightUnitCount+Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGLeftAvailable</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGLeftAvailable-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 1,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGRightAvailable</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGRightAvailable-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingWIP-VSM_AllocUnits</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingExitedUnits</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingExitedUnits+VSM_AllocUnits</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingLeftWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingLeftWIP-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 1,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingRightWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingRightWIP-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="11" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增交付分配" Description="新增交付分配；建立新输出行并绑定当前令牌/库存实体，后续Assign冻结事件时状态值。" ID="11">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value />
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation</Property>
        <Property Name="KeyColumnValue" />
        <Property Name="AddRowCondition" />
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="12" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本次部分交付" Description="冻结本次部分交付；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="12">

        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DemandID</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.SourceID</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Product</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.StockRow</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocStock</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Units</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocUnits</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.OnTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(TimeNow <= VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DueTime,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.CTKnown</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.ShipmentTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>

              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DueTime</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.ManufacturingCT</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].FinishTime-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.FGWait</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].FinishTime</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.EndToEnd</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,TimeNow-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.InitialRemainingDelivery</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime<0,TimeNow,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Version</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ModelVersion</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Replication</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Run.ReplicationNumber</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.RandomnessDisabled</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(Run.RandomnessDisabled,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="13" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="跳过耗尽库存" Description="跳过耗尽库存；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="13">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocStock</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].RemainingUnits == 0,VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].NextRow,VSM_AllocStock)</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="保存产品游标" Description="保存产品游标；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="14">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_DemandLeftCursor</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==1,VSM_AllocDemand,VSM_DemandLeftCursor)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_DemandRightCursor</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==2,VSM_AllocDemand,VSM_DemandRightCursor)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGLeftHead</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==1,VSM_AllocStock,VSM_FGLeftHead)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGRightHead</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==2,VSM_AllocStock,VSM_FGRightHead)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_AllocProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocProduct+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition" />
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="15" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="继续右件分配" Description="继续右件分配；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="15">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_AllocProduct <= 2</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="16" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Fire" Name="通知库存分配完成" Description="通知库存分配完成；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="16">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="EventName">VSM_InventoryAllocated</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>

  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.SumOfSamples(Random.Exponential(VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessTimeSeconds,VSM_OperationTable[1].ProcessingStream),ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>

<Process Name="VSM_PrepareAssembly2" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="设备容量已分配后，先冻结每件独立指数加工样本总和，再按前后产品冻结换型时间；随后更新设备产品，原生Server负责占用、故障暂停及剩余时间恢复。">

    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>

  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="冻结本工序时间" Description="冻结本工序时间；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_OperationStartTime</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">TimeNow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ServiceTime</Value>
              </Property>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>

            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SetupTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_EnableSetups==1 && VSM_Assembly2LastProduct!="" && VSM_Assembly2LastProduct!=ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState,VSM_OperationTable[5].SetupMinutes,0)</Property>

          </Rows>
        </Property>

        <Property Name="StateVariableName">

          <Rows>

                <Value>VSM_Assembly2LastProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

items.name: 说明
items.value: Stamping：工序均值/换型/随机流引用VSM_OperationTable第1行。单件SCV=1、独立累加；开始时冻结。仅产品变更换型，首件不加。换型与加工使用同一Server原生容量和故障暂停/续作，合计占用但分别输出时间；原生Setup状态未单列。
items.description: 说明文字此实例。

items.name: Initial Capacity
items.description:
The initial fixed capacity of this resource.

NOTE: Refer to work schedules or the user-assignable 'CurrentCapacity' state variable of a resource to dynamically change its usage capacity during a simulation run.

items.name: Transfer-Out Constraints
items.description:
Indicates the type of constraints used to determine whether entities can transfer out of this fixed object via external output nodes.

If specified as 'Default', then the 'Can Transfer In & Out Of Objects' property setting for the entity type will determine whether an entity can perform a transfer out of the object.

items.name: Processing Time
items.description: The time required to process an entity.

items.name: Failure Type
items.description: Specifies whether this object has failures that affect the object's availability, and the method used to trigger the failure occurrences.

items.name: Uptime Between Failures
items.description: The uptime between failure occurrences.

items.name: Time To Repair
items.description: The time required to repair a failure when one occurs.

items.name: Entered
items.description: Occurs immediately after an entity has entered this object and is about to start the 'Transfer-In Time'.

items.name: Before Processing
items.description: Occurs when an entity has been allocated Server capacity, but before entering (or ending transfer into) its processing station.

items.name: After Processing
items.description: Occurs when an entity has completed the processing time and is about to attempt its exit from the Server's processing station.

items.name: Exited
items.description: Occurs when an entity has exited this object.

<Process Name="VSM_InitializeWIP" BeginStepID="2" Description="按 VSM_InitialWIPTable 在仿真初始化时按计算批次创建初始在制品；每个实体由 BatchUnitQuantity 表示工件件数，尾批可以小于20件；然后送入统一分流节点。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Search" Name="遍历初始WIP记录" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CollectionType">TableRows</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectInstanceName"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectType"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="QueueStateName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_InitialWIPTable</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchRelatedRowsOnly">False</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NodeListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="TransporterListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NetworkName">
          <Value>Global</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SearchType">Forward</Property>
        <Property Name="MatchCondition">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount > 0</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchExpression">0.0</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveSearchExpressionSum">
          <Value>Token.ReturnValue</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="Limit">Infinity</Property>
        <Property Name="StartingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="EndingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="SaveIndexFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SaveNumberFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="CopyOverTableRowReferences">True</Property>
        <Property Name="SetTableRowConflictResolution">Replace</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Found" Type="Alternate" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Create" Name="按计算批次创建实体" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CreateType">NewObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OriginalEntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenAssociatedObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="TokenContextObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="NumberToCreate">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveCreatedEntityReference">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Created" Type="Alternate" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="初始化实体业务属性" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"WIP:" + VSM_InitialWIPTable.WIPRecordId</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ReleaseTimeHours</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.TrayID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Left", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialRightUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Right", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Transfer" Name="送入初始WIP分流节点" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="EntityType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FromType">FreeSpace</Property>
        <Property Name="ToType">Node</Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName">Transfer_InitialWIP</Property>
        <Property Name="ExternalNodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="StationName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ContainerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FacilityName"></Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkPreference">Default</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkRule">ShortestPath</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkName"></Property>
        <Property Name="FlowRegulatorName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="PathPlannerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
        <Property Name="FailIfBlocked">False</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilTransferred</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记初始库存来源" Description="登记初始库存来源；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.SourceRow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received + ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>

              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>

<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">

    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
